title: Infrared Hotspot-Guided Early Warning of Lithium-Ion Battery Thermal Runaway Under Mechanical Abuse
abstract: arXiv:2608.20383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mechanical abuse can trigger thermal runaway (TR) in lithium-ion batteries through localized heat generation before sensor signals become decisive. This paper proposes a two-stage early-warning approach that estimates localized thermal instability from infrared hotspot dynamics and then fuses this instability score with mechanical, electrical, thermal, and image-intensity features for a 20-frame warning horizon. Evaluation uses repeated experiment-wise three-fold validation, with out-of-fold Stage-I scores during Stage-II training to prevent stacked-model optimism. Hotspot dynamics alone achieve Stage-I ROC-AUC 0.945, and the two-stage classifier reaches Stage-II ROC-AUC 0.908, exceeding direct multimodal fusion while preserving an interpretable intermediate instability signal. translated_title: 红外热点引导的锂离子电池机械滥用下热失控早期预警
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20383v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：机械滥用可通过局部产热在传感器信号变得决定性之前触发锂离子电池的热失控（TR）。本文提出了一种两阶段早期预警方法，该方法从红外热点动态中估计局部热不稳定性，然后将该不稳定性评分与机械、电气、热和图像强度特征融合，以实现20帧的预警窗口。评估采用重复的实验-wise三折验证，在第二阶段训练期间使用折外第一阶段评分以防止堆叠模型乐观偏差。仅凭热点动态即可达到第一阶段ROC-AUC 0.945，而两阶段分类器达到第二阶段ROC-AUC 0.908，超过了直接多模态融合，同时保留了可解释的中间不稳定性信号。热梯度上升平均比基于电压的检测提前40帧（4秒），从而能够更早地进行电池管理系统干预。提前时间a
tldr: 本文提出一种基于红外热点动态的两阶段早期预警方法，可在电压检测前平均4秒识别锂离子电池热失控，并通过可解释的不稳定性评分提升预警准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage early-warning approach using infrared hotspot dynamics to detect lithium-ion battery thermal runaway, achieving an average 4-second lead time over voltage-based detection with an interpretable instability score.
